$comment: Fictional elements. Deliberately NOT mapped to the real periodic table, per ElementSO.cs in Project_Maelstrom.

elements.name: Pyron
elements.description: Fire-essence. The appetite for change; everything Pyron touches becomes something else, whether it wanted to or not.

elements.name: Aqualis
elements.description: Water-essence. The universal solvent of form. Alchemists call it the patient element.

elements.name: Terran
elements.description: Earth-essence. Mass, weight, permanence. The stubborn floor beneath every other element.

elements.name: Zephyr
elements.description: Air-essence. Motion and breath. Refuses to be stored for long; escapes any vessel eventually.

elements.name: Verdant
elements.description: Life-essence. Growth, mending, and the quiet insistence of things that want to keep existing.

elements.name: Ferric
elements.description: Binding-essence. Structure, edge, and the will to hold a shape under load.

elements.name: Lumis
elements.description: Light-essence. Clarity and revelation. Shows a thing as it is, which is not always a kindness.

elements.name: Umbral
elements.description: Shadow-essence. Concealment and the space between. Not evil, merely unlit.

elements.name: Aether
elements.description: Void-essence. The maelstrom itself, ground fine enough to hold. Every alchemist's last ingredient.
